guidelineReference: SJA First Aid / fractures and splinting
title: Open arm fracture at a mountain biking race
setting: Mountain biking race. Participant fell off bike, landed on hand. Open fracture to right arm, bleeding, in severe pain.
verdictExplanation: Open right arm fracture with severe bleeding, pain 9/10, pale/sweating, and hypotension (90/60). Sick: immediate immobilization, bleed control, and 999.

shared.circulation: Skin is pale, cold, and clammy

history.complaint: Open fracture in the right arm
history.history: Fell off bike at speed, landed on right hand 5 minutes ago
history.injuries: Open fracture wound on right forearm, bone visible, bleeding

followUp.question: What is the correct first aid management for this open fracture?

options.text: Control bleeding with direct pressure on wound edges, support arm with a sling/splint, and call 999
Push the visible bone back into the arm to reduce the fracture
Administer ibuprofen immediately to reduce pain
Instruct him to walk to the exit to clear the track

followUp.explanation: Control bleeding by applying direct pressure around the wound edges, avoiding the bone. Support and immobilize the arm. Call 999. Never push a bone back into a wound. Ibuprofen is contraindicated due to allergy. Never allow walking.

levelFlags.cfaNotes: Apply direct pressure to wound edges, immobilize. Call 999.
levelFlags.erNotes: Open fracture. Dress with sterile wet-to-dry dressings. Splint in position of comfort. Administer high-flow oxygen, check BGL, manage pain within scope (avoiding NSAIDs/ibuprofen), and transport priority.
